decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach along with a variety of artifacts and spells to create a powerful combo that allows for infinite loops and potential win conditions. The deck includes cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to help dig for combo pieces, as well as cards like Grinding Station and Malevolent Rumble to help set up the combo. The goal is to chain spells and artifacts together to create a loop that ends with either milling the opponent's library or dealing lethal damage with Grapeshot.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting opponent's game plan with a mix of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells. It aims to outvalue the opponent by controlling the board and hand through cards like Thoughtseize, Counterspell, and Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to close out the game. The inclusion of Subtlety and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student ensures a versatile gameplay. Overall, the deck's goal is to maintain control of the game while slowly wearing down the opponent's resources.

The deck revolves around utilizing Amulet of Vigor to accelerate the mana production of lands, allowing for explosive plays with Primeval Titan and Scapeshift. The deck aims to tutor for key pieces with Summoner's Pact and Green Sun's Zenith, while also utilizing lands like Urza's Saga and Lotus Field to generate additional value. The inclusion of Aftermath Analyst and Vexing Bauble provide additional utility and card advantage, with the overall goal of assembling a powerful board state and overwhelming the opponent with big creatures and direct damage.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive creatures, backed up by powerful spells and enchantments to control the board and close out the game quickly. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide early threats, while Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Guide of Souls pump up the team for lethal attacks. Ranger-Captain of Eos helps find key creatures, while cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment provide additional reach and removal. The deck also utilizes Static Prison and Arena of Glory to limit the opponent's options and ensure victory.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Amulet of Vigor to cheat out powerful land-based threats like Primeval Titan and Vesuva. It utilizes the unique abilities of Urza's Saga to tutor for key artifacts and lands, while also running cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Scapeshift to enable explosive combo potential. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of fast mana acceleration and powerful land synergies to create a dominant board state.

The deck focuses on utilizing the interaction between Underworld Breach and various artifacts to repeatedly cycle through the graveyard and generate a large amount of mana to support powerful combo plays. The deck also includes control elements such as Swan Song and Lightning Bolt to disrupt the opponent's game plan while searching for the key pieces needed to execute the combo. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a burst of damage or card advantage, utilizing the synergies between the cards to achieve a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively play low-cost creatures and spells to deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent. The deck focuses on using powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Boros Charm to finish off the opponent's life total while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Searing Blaze and Skullcrack. The addition of cards like Roiling Vortex also helps to prevent the opponent from gaining life or stabilizing, allowing the deck to maintain its aggressive momentum throughout the game.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures combined with blink effects to maximize their value. The aim is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Ketramose, the New Dawn, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can repeatedly blink key creatures, triggering their enter-the-battlefield effects multiple times. This strategy aims to outpace the opponent and maintain board control in order to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and powerful combat tricks to quickly overwhelm opponents. By combining efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury with support cards like Guide of Souls and Galvanic Discharge, players can maintain pressure on their opponent while controlling the board. The inclusion of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ranger-Captain of Eos provides additional utility and disruption, while cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison offer versatile removal options. The deck is designed to be fast and unforgiving, aiming to end games quickly through a combination of aggression and versatility.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the card Underworld Breach in combination with various artifacts and spells to create a looping combo that can generate infinite mana and mill the opponent's library. The deck aims to quickly set up its key pieces such as Grinding Station, Mox Opal, and Mishra's Bauble to enable the combo. This combo-oriented strategy allows the player to potentially win the game in a single turn by overwhelming the opponent with a barrage of spells or by milling their entire deck.

The deck focuses on using ramp spells and mana acceleration to quickly cast powerful Eldrazi creatures, such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also includes control elements like Chalice of the Void and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large threats while controlling the board and disrupting their strategy. It combines the ramp and control aspects of the Eldrazi archetype to create a versatile and powerful Modern deck.

This Jeskai Control deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and board wipes. The deck also includes cards that provide card advantage and card selection, allowing the player to outvalue their opponent over the course of the game. Teferi, Time Raveler acts as a versatile threat and disruption piece, while Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury serves as a win condition. The mana base is constructed to support the deck's three-color requirements and includes utility lands like Arena of Glory for additional advantage.

The main concept of this Modern Aggro Merfolk deck is to quickly swarm the board with powerful Merfolk creatures, supported by Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident to buff them up. Using Aether Vial and Cavern of Souls to cheat creatures onto the board and protect them with counterspells like Force of Negation and Flare of Denial. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game with disruptive cards like Sink into Stupor and Dismember while maintaining aggressive pressure. Overall, the strategy focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a fast and efficient Merfolk tribal theme.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays combined with the ability to repeatedly "blink" or exile and return creatures for additional value. The main strategy is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures like Solitude and Ketramose, while using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to continuously generate advantage by reusing their abilities. The deck also includes disruption spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's game plan, making it harder for them to stabilize against the aggressive threats.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be repeatedly blinked in and out of play to generate value. The key strategy involves using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to blink powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Ketramose, the New Dawn, allowing them to dodge removal and trigger powerful abilities multiple times. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the game while setting up its aggressive game plan. The deck's synergy between aggressive creatures and blink effects is what makes it unique and powerful in Modern.

The main focus of this deck is to gain control of the game by disrupting the opponent's plans and preventing them from executing their strategy. This is achieved through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler to further control the board state. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the control elements of the deck, ensuring that the player can consistently cast spells and control the game.
